title.title: Title
title.description: Heading shown at the top of the tile. Leave it empty to show no heading.

subTitle.title: Subtitle
subTitle.description: Smaller text below the title, for context such as the location or the data source.

dataseries.title: Data Series
dataseries.description: The readouts on this tile. Each entry is one labelled number, or one number per distinct pivot value of its data.

label.title: Label
label.description: Name shown above the number, such as 'Spindle speed'. With a pivot it follows the pivot value: '<pivot> - <label>'.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit shown after the number, such as '°C', 'rpm' or '%'.

precision.title: Decimals
precision.description: Number of decimal places shown. Leave it empty for whole numbers.

color.title: Value Color
color.description: Colour of the number. Leave it empty to use the board's text colour.

data.title: Data
data.description: Rows of this series, oldest first; the newest row is shown. Bind it to a table, with the number in Value and optionally a column in Split Data By.

pivot.title: Split Data By
pivot.description: Column whose distinct values each get their own readout, such as a machine id, to show one number per machine.
